notes: The official download page offers Mixxx for macOS 11 or later and states there is no official paid or pro version. The Homebrew cask mixxx is active.

name: MKVToolNix
notes: The official downloads page provides DMGs for macOS 13 and newer and names the Homebrew cask mkvtoolnix-app, which is active. Free and open source.

name: Mnemosyne
notes: The official download page gives macOS install steps using the project's own installer script. Free and open source; there is no Homebrew cask, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Money Manager Ex is a personal finance manager with budgeting, reporting and multi-currency support. It is released under the GPL.
name: Money Manager Ex
notes: The official download page offers a macOS universal build and the Homebrew cask mmex is active. Free and open source with no ads or purchases.

description: Stream games from a PC to other devices.
name: Moonlight
notes: The official site lists Mac among its client platforms and states Moonlight is completely free with no ads, paid versions or subscriptions. The Homebrew cask moonlight is active for macOS 13 and later.

description: Developer edition of Firefox with experimental tools and a separate release channel, under the same MPL 2.0 license.
name: Mozilla Firefox Developer Edition
notes: The Homebrew cask firefox@developer-edition is active and installs Mozilla's official macOS build. Free and open source.

description: Web browser from Mozilla, released under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
name: Mozilla Firefox
notes: The Homebrew cask firefox is active and installs Mozilla's official macOS build. Free and open source with no purchases.

description: Email, news, calendar and chat client from the Mozilla project.
name: Mozilla Thunderbird
notes: The Homebrew cask thunderbird is active and installs the official macOS build from the Mozilla project. Free and open source.

description: Minimal, scriptable media player with high-quality rendering and no GUI chrome.
name: MPV
notes: The official installation page lists macOS builds, including first-party CI builds and the long-standing stolendata builds. There is no Homebrew cask for mpv, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Low-latency voice chat for groups and gaming communities.
name: Mumble
notes: The official downloads page provides macOS builds (the last 1.5 series release on macOS is 1.5.901). The Homebrew cask mumble is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Music notation software for composing, engraving and playing back scores.
name: MuseScore
notes: The official download page offers MuseScore Studio for macOS 11 or later as a free download and the Homebrew cask musescore is active. The notation app itself is free and open source.

description: Music tagger that identifies tracks acoustically and writes metadata from MusicBrainz.
name: MusicBrainz Picard
notes: The official downloads page offers Picard 3.0.2 for macOS 13 and later on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. The Homebrew cask musicbrainz-picard is active.

description: Distraction-free painting app with a large brush library and infinite canvas.
name: MyPaint
notes: See review_notes: no official macOS binary is published.
review_notes: The official releases ship Windows installers and Linux AppImages only; on Mac it is available only as a MacPorts source build with no dedicated compiled macOS version, so a current Mac version could not be verified.

description: Document scanning app that saves scans as PDF, TIFF, JPEG or PNG. Includes OCR, deskew and batch scanning.
name: NAPS2
notes: The official Mac page offers a universal installer plus Apple Silicon and Intel installers, and the site states the app is free and open source with no ads. The Homebrew cask naps2 is active for macOS 12 and later.

description: Classic roguelike dungeon crawler with permadeath and deep item interactions.
name: NetHack
notes: See review_notes: current releases are source-only for macOS.
review_notes: The NetHack 5.0.0 downloads page lists official binaries only for MS-DOS, Windows and Amiga; macOS appears only in the source release, and official Mac binaries stopped at 3.6.2, so no current Mac build could be verified.

description: Online multiplayer real-time tactical tank combat game.
name: netPanzer
notes: See review_notes: macOS support is compile-from-source only.
review_notes: The 0.9.0 release notes say the game can now compile for macOS, but no Mac download is offered and the official site lists Windows and Linux as the compatible systems, so no Mac build could be verified.

description: Tilt the floor to roll a ball through 3D obstacle courses and collect enough coins to open the goal. Bundles the Neverputt mini golf game.
name: Neverball
notes: The official site describes Neverball as free and open source for Linux, Windows and macOS, with the desktop download bundling Neverputt and a listed price of 0 USD. No Homebrew cask exists.

description: Fast, private Qt-based note-taking app with Markdown support, folders, tags, themes and a Markdown-to-Kanban board.
free_enough_reason: A paid Pro license exists but only unlocks editing inside the Kanban view and a year of Pro updates; the free app is otherwise complete, and all Pro features are available free by building from source.
name: Notes
notes: The official site states Notes is built on Qt and available on Windows, Linux and macOS, with local-first storage. The Pro licence shape is the same as on Windows.

description: Screen recording and live streaming studio with scenes, sources and filters.
name: OBS Studio
notes: The official site offers OBS Studio for Windows, Mac and Linux as free and open source software. The Homebrew cask obs is active for macOS 13 and later.

description: Local-first note-taking app built on plain Markdown files. Includes bidirectional linking, graph view, Canvas and thousands of community plugins.
free_enough_reason: Core app is free forever for any purpose including commercial; Catalyst (from $25 one-time) is a voluntary supporter tier that unlocks no features, and Sync ($4-5/mo) and Publish ($8-10/mo) are optional add-ons.
name: Obsidian
notes: The Homebrew cask obsidian is active for macOS 12 and later on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and installs the official Obsidian.app. The pricing shape is the same as on Windows.

description: Ambient sound mixer that blends dozens of sounds like rain, thunder, fire and office noise into custom relaxing environments.
name: Opal
notes: See review_notes: macOS is supported only as a do-it-yourself build.
review_notes: The README documents building a macOS dmg with Gradle and jpackage on a Mac host, but no prebuilt Mac download is published with the releases, so a Mac version a visitor can simply download could not be verified.

description: A tool for controlling RGB lighting across motherboards, RAM, fans and peripherals from one interface.
name: OpenRGB
notes: The official site states OpenRGB runs on Windows, Linux and MacOS and is free and open source under GPL-2. The Homebrew cask openrgb exists but is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Video editor with timeline trimming, transitions, titles and keyframe animation.
name: OpenShot
notes: The official site presents OpenShot as a free and open source editor for Linux, Mac and Windows with no subscriptions or watermarks. The Homebrew cask openshot-video-editor is active.

description: Open-source remake of Transport Tycoon Deluxe; build transport networks and run a company.
name: OpenTTD
notes: The official download page publishes the latest stable release with a macOS build among its binaries. The Homebrew cask openttd is active and installs OpenTTD.app.

description: Gaming-oriented variant of the Opera browser with CPU, RAM and network limiters.
free_enough_reason: paid VPN Pro and AI upgrades exist, but the free browser is complete with no ads, trials or feature gating.
name: Opera GX
notes: The Homebrew cask opera-gx is active for macOS 13 and later and installs the official Opera GX.app from opera.com/gx. The paid upgrade shape is the same as on Windows.

description: Chromium-based web browser with a built-in sidebar, Flow sync and optional VPN.
free_enough_reason: paid VPN Pro and AI upgrades exist, but the free browser is complete with no ads, trials or feature gating.
name: Opera
notes: The Homebrew cask opera is active for macOS 13 and later and installs the official Opera.app from opera.com. The paid upgrade shape is the same as on Windows.

description: Qt-based browser that recreates the classic Opera 12 interface, maintained as open source.
name: Otter Browser
notes: The official site publishes its ongoing binary releases with a DMG for macOS alongside the Windows and Linux packages. No Homebrew cask exists.

description: Password manager originally designed by Bruce Schneier. Stores logins in an encrypted database file.
name: Password Safe
notes: The official GitHub releases ship a PasswordSafe macOS universal dmg alongside the Windows and Linux builds, with macOS-specific fixes in the release notes. No Homebrew cask exists.

description: Merges, splits, rotates and reorders PDF pages via drag and drop.
name: PDF Arranger
notes: See review_notes: macOS is a source install only.
review_notes: Downloads are offered for Windows and Linux only; the repo documents running on macOS from source (macOS.md) but publishes no Mac binary and there is no Homebrew cask, so a Mac version a visitor can simply download could not be verified.

description: Splits, merges, rotates and extracts pages from PDF files.

name: PDFsam Basic
notes: The official site lists PDFsam Basic for Windows, macOS and Linux as free and open source with no watermarks and no limits, separate from the paid Visual and Enhanced editions. The Homebrew cask pdfsam-basic is active.

description: File archiver and manager that supports many archive formats. Released under the LGPLv3.
name: PeaZip
notes: The official site offers PeaZip for macOS on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and states all packages contain no advertising. No Homebrew cask exists.

description: GUI prototyping and diagramming tool for mockups, wireframes and flowcharts.
name: Pencil Project
notes: The official site describes Pencil as an open-source GUI prototyping tool available for all platforms, with version 3.1.1 for Mac. The Homebrew cask pencil is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Hand-drawn 2D animation and drawing application.
name: Pencil2D
notes: The official download page offers Pencil2D 0.7.2 for macOS and gives the Homebrew cask command. The cask pencil2d is active; the build is for Intel Macs and needs Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

description: Guide penguins safely to the exit using skills in the Lemmings style.
name: Pingus
notes: The official download page lists MacOSX builds of Pingus 0.7.6 as DMG files for Intel Macs. It is an older build and there is no Homebrew cask.

description: Simple drawing and image-editing program modeled on Paint.NET with layers and effects.
name: Pinta
notes: The official site states Pinta is free and open source and available on Mac. The Homebrew cask pinta is active at version 3.1.2 for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

description: Pixel art editor for sprites, tiles and animations with onion skinning, palette management and sprite-sheet export. Built on Godot.
name: Pixelorama
notes: The official manual confirms Pixelorama runs on desktop platforms including macOS, and the Homebrew cask page lists a Pixelorama.app for macOS. The cask pixelorama is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Free open-source Texas Hold'em. Play offline against computer opponents, on a LAN or over the internet. All chips are play money.
name: PokerTH
notes: The Homebrew cask page lists a PokerTH.app requiring macOS 12 or later, confirming a Mac build. The cask pokerth is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded and the download is via the official site.

description: SSH, telnet and serial client for Windows and Unix, released under the MIT license.
name: PuTTY
notes: PuTTY is a Windows and Unix program; on macOS it is distributed as binary packages through the Homebrew formula putty, with bottles for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. That is a formula rather than a cask, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Portable app suite and menu that ties portable apps together with an app store, automatic updates, themes and backup.
name: PortableApps.com Platform
notes: See review_notes: macOS support is not a native Mac build.
review_notes: The download page lists Windows as the operating system and says the platform is also available on macOS, but that support works through a macOS Helper that runs the platform inside a bundled Windows instance rather than as a native Mac app, so a native Mac version could not be verified.

description: Collection of dozens of single-player logic puzzles by Simon Tatham.
name: Puzzle Collection

description: A calculator that supports symbolic calculation, unit conversion, plotting and currency conversion.
name: Qalculate
notes: The official downloads page has a Mac OS binaries section linking to Qalculate at MacPorts and to Homebrew formulae for the GTK and Qt interfaces. There is no standalone Mac installer or cask, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Community fork of qBittorrent with extra anti-leech and blocking features, under the same GPLv2 license.
name: qBittorrent Enhanced
notes: See review_notes: no official macOS download was found.
review_notes: The project README lists macOS only through a third-party Homebrew tap maintained by an individual, and no official macOS download or Homebrew cask for the Enhanced Edition could be verified.

description: BitTorrent client released under the GPLv2 with no ads, trials or bundled offers.
name: qBittorrent
notes: The official download page offers qBittorrent 5.2.3 as macOS DMG files and notes the macOS version is barely supported for lack of Mac developers. The Homebrew cask qbittorrent is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Plain-text Markdown note-taking app storing notes as local files, with tags, scripting, optional AES-256 encryption and Nextcloud/ownCloud integration.
name: QOwnNotes
notes: The official macOS installation page offers QOwnNotes.dmg as a universal binary requiring macOS 13 or later, plus a Qt5 legacy DMG. The Homebrew cask qownnotes is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Desktop client for the Tox messaging network.
name: qTox
notes: The project README lists an OS X latest release and nightly builds alongside the Windows and Linux downloads. The repository is archived and the project is unmaintained, matching the Windows record.

description: RSS and Atom feed reader with a built-in browser, feed filters and OPML import and export.
name: QuiteRSS

description: RAW photo processor with advanced demosaicing, color management and batch queues.
name: RawTherapee
notes: The official site states RawTherapee runs on macOS and is free and open source under GPLv3. The Homebrew cask rawtherapee is active.

description: Desktop journal and diary with calendar navigation, tags, templates, spell check and export to plain text, HTML, LaTeX or PDF.
name: RedNotebook
notes: See review_notes: installers are published for Linux and Windows only; macOS is documented as run-from-source.
review_notes: Installers are published only for Linux and Windows; on macOS the project documents running from source only, so no installable Mac version could be verified.

description: Frontend for emulators and game engines with unified controls and shaders.
name: RetroArch
notes: The official platforms page lists macOS downloads for stable and nightly builds. The Mac version is not sold through the Mac App Store. The Homebrew cask retroarch is active.

description: Friend-to-friend network for encrypted messaging, forums and file sharing.
name: RetroShare
notes: The official downloads page offers RetroShare 0.6.7a dmg files for macOS. The Homebrew cask retroshare is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Scrolling tile-based game combining Boulder Dash, Emerald Mine, Supaplex and Sokoban. Includes a level editor and tens of thousands of community levels.
name: Rocks'n'Diamonds
notes: The official download page offers version 4.4.2.4 as a Mac Universal Binary dmg. The Homebrew cask rocks-n-diamonds is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Actively developed open-source RSS reader for Windows, Linux and macOS.
name: RSS Guard
notes: The project page states RSS Guard runs on macOS and ships packages for Intel Macs and Apple Silicon. No Homebrew cask exists.

notes: The official site lists macOS among its supported platforms and the client download is the same free build as on Windows. The Homebrew cask rustdesk is active for macOS 12 and later.

description: Multiplayer and single-player first-person shooter with in-game level editing.
name: Sauerbraten
notes: The official site offers a MacOS download of the 2020 Edition next to the Windows and Linux downloads and states the game is free. The Homebrew cask sauerbraten is active.

description: 3D turn-based artillery game where tanks blast each other across destructible terrain, with single player, LAN and internet play.

name: SeaMonkey

notes: The official download page offers the current version for macOS 12 and later as a free download and pledges the downloads are free of adware. Shotcut is not sold on the Mac App Store. The Homebrew cask shotcut is active.

description: WYSIWYG and code-view EPUB ebook editor with metadata editing, TOC generation and validation.
name: Sigil
notes: The official download page offers macOS builds for Intel and Arm64 and states Sigil runs on macOS 13 and newer. The Homebrew cask sigil is active.

description: Deblurs out-of-focus and motion-blurred photos with blind deconvolution algorithms.

description: Graphical front-end for MPlayer/mpv with subtitle search and YouTube playback.
name: SMPlayer
notes: The official downloads page lists macOS as a supported system for the current version and calls SMPlayer a free media player. The Homebrew cask smplayer is marked disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: A keyboard-driven scientific calculator with scrollable history and syntax highlighting.
name: SpeedCrunch
notes: Free and open source. The official site offers the macOS build as a free download; the Homebrew cask is disabled, so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Multi-platform Atari 2600 emulator; plays Atari 2600 games and homebrew ROMs.
name: Stella
notes: Free and open source under the GPL. The official site lists macOS among its supported platforms and the Homebrew cask is active.

description: Planetarium app that renders a realistic night sky for any location and date, with deep-sky catalog data.
name: Stellarium
notes: Free and open source. The official site lists macOS in its system requirements and the Homebrew cask is active.

description: Lightweight email and news client.
name: Sylpheed

review_notes: Official site claims Mac OS X support, but only Windows binaries are published; on Mac it is available only as a source or package-manager build, so there is no verified official Mac download.

description: Continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between devices directly, with no central server.
name: Syncthing
notes: Free and open source under the MPL-2.0. The official downloads page links a macOS application bundle, also published as the syncthing-app Homebrew cask.

description: A to-do manager with hierarchical tasks, effort tracking and reminders.

description: Desktop client for the Telegram messenger.

description: Falling-sand physics sandbox that simulates air pressure, heat, gravity and hundreds of interacting substances. Browse and upload community creations.

description: Web browser that routes traffic through the Tor network for anonymous browsing. Free and open source; donations fund development.
name: Tor Browser
notes: Free and open source from the Tor Project. The macOS build is distributed from the official download page and as an active Homebrew cask.

description: Lightweight BitTorrent client with a minimal interface, native on macOS.

description: 2D platformer where you play Tux, the Linux mascot, rescuing Penny across multiple worlds. Includes a level editor.

notes: Free and open source. The official download page offers macOS disk images for Apple Silicon and Intel.

description: 3D kart racing game with a story mode and multiplayer.

notes: Free and open source. The macOS build is distributed from the official site and as an active Homebrew cask.

description: Open source tool that creates bootable USB drives for Linux distributions.

description: Microsoft's code editor with debugging, syntax highlighting and a large extension marketplace.

description: Batch image converter and resizer with over 80 actions and live preview.

description: Modern cross-platform image browser with tabbed interface, rating and cataloging.
name: XnView MP
notes: Free for personal and non-commercial use; commercial users need a license. Verified through the Homebrew cask, which installs the current build from the developer's download server for macOS 12 or later.

description: Fast multiplayer arena first-person shooter with a large weapon set.

description: WizTree is a disk space analyzer that scans drives quickly. The Mac build is called WizTreeMac and is free for personal use only; commercial use requires a paid license.
name: WizTree
notes: WizTreeMac 1.00 shipped with WizTree 4.33 for macOS 12 or later, with most of the Windows version's functionality. The free version shows a donation button and adds a donation message to exports, the same terms as the Windows free version.

description: Challenging 2D motocross platformer where physics matter. Collect strawberries and touch the flower to finish; thousands of user-made levels.
name: X-Moto
notes: The official site offers a macOS bundle (arm64) of the current 0.6.3 release alongside the Windows builds. GPL-2.0-or-later.

description: Video conferencing app for meetings, webinars and chat. Free Basic plan supports up to 100 participants.
free_enough_reason: Basic is a permanent free plan with unlimited meetings for up to 100 participants; the 40-minute per-meeting cap is a standing product limit, not a trial. Zoom Workplace Pro, which removes the cap, costs $16.99 per month.
name: Zoom
notes: The Mac client is a free download from Zoom and is also available as a Homebrew cask. Hosting a meeting requires a free Zoom account.

description: Move and resize windows with keyboard shortcuts or by dragging them to snap areas at the screen edges and corners.
free_enough_reason: Rectangle Pro, a separate app from the same developer, adds custom snap areas, window throwing and workspace layouts for $9.99 one time; the free Rectangle app is complete.
name: Rectangle
notes: Free and open source (MIT), distributed from the developer's site and Homebrew. Rectangle Pro is a separate paid app from the same developer; the free app is complete on its own.

description: Brings Windows-style alt-tab window switching to macOS, with live previews of every window across all Spaces and monitors, including minimized and hidden windows.
free_enough_reason: AltTab Pro adds window search, extra switcher styles, auto-sizing and up to nine shortcuts for $9.99 one time; the free window switcher is complete.
name: AltTab
notes: Free and open source (GPL-3.0), distributed from the developer's site and Homebrew. The core window switcher is free forever; Pro is an optional one-time licence.

description: Menu bar system monitor showing CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network use, plus battery level, fan and sensor readings.
name: Stats
notes: Free and open source (MIT), distributed from GitHub and Homebrew. An optional System Stats account exists for remote monitoring of other machines; local monitoring needs no account.

description: Lightweight clipboard manager that keeps a history of what you copy and lets you search it and paste earlier items with a keyboard shortcut.
name: Maccy
notes: Free and open source (MIT), distributed from the developer's site, GitHub and Homebrew.

description: Plain-text editor for macOS with syntax highlighting for more than 60 languages, powerful find and replace and scripting support.
free_enough_reason: Optional donation in-app purchases (Espresso $4.99 and Coffee Beans $19.99) support the project and unlock nothing; every feature is free.
name: CotEditor
notes: Free and open source. The developer states on the App Store page that all features are available for free; the in-app purchases are optional donations that unlock nothing.

description: Menu bar manager that hides, shows and arranges menu bar items, with hotkeys and control over the menu bar's tint, shadow and shape.
name: Ice
notes: Free and open source (GPL-3.0), distributed from GitHub and Homebrew.

description: Tiny menu bar calendar that displays your Calendar app events, creates events and joins meetings, and can replace the system clock.
name: Itsycal
notes: Free download from the developer's site; also in Homebrew.

description: Controls an external display's brightness, volume and contrast from the menu bar or the keyboard, showing the native macOS on-screen display.
name: MonitorControl
notes: Free and open source (MIT), distributed from GitHub and Homebrew.

description: Mouse and trackpad utility with per-device and per-app settings for scrolling direction, pointer acceleration and speed, and button remapping.
name: LinearMouse
notes: Free and open source (MIT), distributed from the developer's site, GitHub and Homebrew.

description: Smooths mouse wheel scrolling so it flows like a trackpad, with per-app profiles, separate axis settings and mouse button bindings.
name: Mos
notes: Free download from the developer's site; also in Homebrew.

description: Keyboard customizer for macOS, from simple key remapping to complex rules, multiple profiles and device-specific settings.
name: Karabiner-Elements
notes: Free and released into the public domain, distributed from the developer's site and Homebrew.

description: Uninstaller that finds the preference files, caches and other files an app has spread across the system and deletes them along with the app.
name: AppCleaner
notes: Free download from the developer's site; also in Homebrew. Closed source.

description: File archiver that creates 7z, Zip, Tar and other archives and extracts nearly any archive format, including RAR.
name: Keka
notes: The download from the official site is free and is the same app the developer sells on the Mac App Store to support development. That paid App Store version is deliberately not listed as a download path here.

description: Media player for macOS built on mpv, with trackpad gestures, Picture in Picture and support for nearly every audio and video format.
name: IINA
notes: Free and open source, distributed from the developer's site and Homebrew. The developer states it includes no tracking or telemetry.

description: Open-source firewall for macOS that blocks unknown outgoing connections and lets you allow or deny each program's network access.
name: LuLu
notes: Free and open source from the Objective-See Foundation. Distributed as a direct download from the developer site (current version 4.5.1, macOS 10.15 and later) and as an active Homebrew cask. The product page states its bundle identifier as com.objective-see.lulu. Not sold through the Mac App Store.

description: Scans the places where software installs itself to run automatically and lists everything that is persistently installed on a Mac.
name: KnockKnock
notes: Free and open source from the Objective-See Foundation, which describes all its tools as free open-source macOS security tools. Direct download from the developer site (macOS 10.15 and later) and an active Homebrew cask. VirusTotal lookups are optional and can be disabled.

description: Monitors common persistence locations and alerts when a new persistent component is installed, with the option to block it.
name: BlockBlock
notes: Free and open source from the Objective-See Foundation. Direct download from the developer site (current version 2.5.2, macOS 10.15 and later) and an active Homebrew cask.

description: Monitors the microphone and webcam on a Mac and alerts whenever a program activates either one, naming the process responsible.
name: OverSight
notes: The developer's FAQ states OverSight is 100% free and open source. Direct download from the Objective-See site (macOS 12 and later) and an active Homebrew cask.

description: Watches for untrusted programs rapidly creating encrypted files and stops them, to protect personal files from ransomware.
name: RansomWhere?
notes: Free and open source from the Objective-See Foundation. Direct download from the developer site (current version 2.2.0, macOS 10.15 and later) and an active Homebrew cask; the cask notes the build is Intel and needs Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon. The product page gives its subsystem identifier as com.objective-see.ransomwhere.

description: Shows every process running on a Mac with its code signing status, loaded libraries, open files and network connections.
name: TaskExplorer
notes: Free and open source from the Objective-See Foundation. Direct download from the developer site (current version 3.1.0, macOS 14 and later) and an active Homebrew cask. VirusTotal checks and the AI assistant are optional and use the user's own free or paid API keys; the on-device assistant needs no key and the core tool needs no account.

description: Multifunction maintenance utility for verifying system files, cleaning caches, rebuilding databases and changing hidden settings in macOS and Apple apps.
name: OnyX
notes: Freeware from Titanium Software. The developer's home page states all its applications are free and fully usable, no registration is necessary, they contain no adware, spyware or other malware, and donations are optional. A separate version is published for each major macOS release. Also available as an active Homebrew cask. Closed source, so no open-source claim is made.

description: Small word processor with a live word count, page layout view, templates and autosave with date-stamped backups.
name: Bean
notes: The developer site states Bean is available free of charge and is provided at no monetary cost. Bean 3.x is closed source, so no open-source claim is made. Direct download from the developer site (current version 3.7.8) and an active Homebrew cask.

description: Text editor for macOS with multiple carets, project-wide search, snippets, macros and bundle-based support for many languages.
name: TextMate
notes: TextMate 2 (current version 2.0.23) is a free download from MacroMates with no licence key or purchase required, and its source is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0, as stated on its GitHub repository. The paid licence from the TextMate 1 era does not apply to the current version. Also an active Homebrew cask.

description: Markdown editor for macOS with live preview, syntax highlighting in code blocks and customisable rendering.
name: MacDown
notes: Open source under the MIT License, as stated on the project site, and distributed as a free download. The Homebrew cask macdown is marked (disabled), so no brew_id is recorded.

description: Desktop YouTube client that plays videos without ads, keeps subscriptions, playlists and history on the local computer and needs no YouTube account.
name: FreeTube
notes: Free and open source under the AGPLv3 licence, as stated on the project site, with Mac downloads for macOS 12 and later. The Homebrew cask freetube is marked (disabled), so no brew_id is recorded. The project also publishes Windows and Linux builds, but the product has no other-platform listing in this catalogue, so no sibling is set.

description: WebKit-based browser for macOS with built-in ad and tracker blocking, no telemetry and support for Chrome, Firefox and Safari extensions.
free_enough_reason: Optional Orion+ supporter subscription ($5 per month, $50 per year or $150 for lifetime) adds release candidates, exclusive app icons and forum perks. Kagi's own documentation states that the Orion browser is free to use, and Orion+ does not include or require Kagi Search.
name: Orion Browser
notes: Free direct download for macOS from Kagi and an active Homebrew cask. No account is needed to download or use the browser, and Kagi Search is a separate paid service that Orion does not require. The Mac version is not sold through the Mac App Store (the App Store listing is for iPhone and iPad), so no stores entry is recorded.

description: App uninstaller for macOS that removes an app together with its leftover files and can find files orphaned by apps already deleted.
name: Pearcleaner
notes: Described by its developer as a free, source-available Mac app cleaner, licensed under Apache 2.0 with Commons Clause, which prohibits monetising it; it is not claimed here as open source. Distributed via GitHub releases and an active Homebrew cask for macOS 13 and later. The developer notes active development is on hold, while the current release (5.4.3) supports recent macOS versions including Tahoe.

description: Small utility that checks whether the apps installed on a Mac are up to date and shows what changed in each update.
name: Latest
notes: The project page on GitHub describes Latest as a free and open-source app for macOS, released under GPL-3.0, with optional donations. It covers apps from the Mac App Store and apps that update through Sparkle. Also an active Homebrew cask.

description: Menu bar utility that prevents a Mac from going to sleep for a chosen period or until it is switched off.
name: KeepingYouAwake
notes: Open source under the MIT License, as stated on its GitHub repository, and built on Apple's caffeinate command-line tool. Free download from the project site and an active Homebrew cask.

description: Blocks access to chosen distracting websites and mail servers for a set period, and keeps the block in place until the timer runs out.
name: SelfControl
notes: The project site describes SelfControl as a free and open-source application for macOS. Direct download from the developer site and an active Homebrew cask. Closest catalogue fit is System/Privacy, since the app controls access to websites.

description: Colour picker for macOS that samples colours anywhere on screen and copies them in formats such as Hex, RGB and HSL, with contrast checks for accessibility.
name: Pika
notes: The developer site describes Pika as an open-source colour picker app for macOS, distributed through GitHub releases and an active Homebrew cask for macOS 14 and later. No Mac App Store entry is recorded, as no App Store page was verified in this pass.
